content.comment_body: I'm facing a small issue. Using external software, I send commands to [product_name] AM11 and AM12: AM11 = 5 starts the timer, AM11 = 10 stops it. I want to set the TH parameter of B003, but haven't managed to link AM12 to TH successfully, despite trying various analog conversions. Any guidance would be appreciated. Thanks!
It's not possible to directly connect the analog flag output to a parameter input field. You'll need to use an analog amplifier, for example. Please refer to the attachment.
Thanks for your help. I actually tried that before, but when monitoring online, I don't see the correct value. The timer itself seems to operate correctly.

You may have overlooked something, which is a common issue for new users. While monitoring online, don't rely on the parameter list below the block, as those are simulation parameters or variables. To view the real-time output of an analog block, move your cursor to it. You'll see a glasses icon appear; click it to display the output value.

I'm new to [product_name]; I usually work with PLCs like [version_no] and [version_no]. This is my first time using [product_name], and the process feels more complex compared to working with AWL or KOP. I appreciate your support!

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble assigning analog memory values to the timer parameter (TH) in [product_name] using external software, especially when trying to connect analog outputs to parameter fields and viewing values online. Compared to previous experience with other [company_name] PLCs, the user finds these tasks more complicated and feels the online monitoring method is confusing, leading to misunderstanding of displayed data.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to easily assign analog memory values to block parameters and monitor live values during online operation, similar to their experience with other [company_name] PLC platforms.
